quote.text: Life is the struggle of delaying death.
quote.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood:
    • Understand that every day with your children is a precious opportunity to mold resilience, teaching them that life’s temporary nature calls for cherishing each moment and nurturing values that transcend the inevitable end.
    • Embrace impermanence by guiding your children to grow through challenges; when they learn that life is a series of struggles and triumphs, they become better equipped to appreciate the present and prepare wisely for the future.
  • Leadership:
    • Recognize that the struggle to delay death is symbolic of any leader’s challenge to build lasting impact—focusing on enduring principles and creating a legacy that outlives temporary setbacks.
    • Accept that every moment is an opportunity to lead with intentionality; by confronting the finite nature of our existence, you are inspired to make decisions that foster resilience, innovation, and ethical growth within your organization.
  • Product Management:
    • See the ephemeral life of products as a reminder to continually innovate; understanding that every product’s lifecycle is finite encourages you to focus on iterative improvement and strategic planning.
    • Embrace the notion that delaying obsolescence—much like life’s struggle—is about adapting, pivoting, and delivering enduring value, ensuring that your teams remain agile and responsive in a rapidly changing market.
